sections.title: Current Admission Status
sections.text: Implementation checkpoint, not a delivered checked execution path. Offline composition is tested, but the current shared strict checker rejects the actual full generated runtime even with verified SDK definitions. The installed guarded SDK control passes; individual generated reads fail too. No positive pack admission or live execution is claimed. Checker/typecheck/identity are not bypassed.

sections.title: One Readonly Composition
sections.text: Compose 1..100 reads in the existing broker SDK turn and CadContext. The catalog inspectionSafe marker is the sole inventory: entity.list, entity.inspect, entity.find, entity.stats and selection.inspect are initially eligible. Other operations, including mutations, file/viewport output, Node coordinators and recursive packs, return unsupported and are never dispatched. This is a standalone CAD operation, not a nested batch step or run-helper input; the ordinary CAD preparation supplies its validated inventory. No second handler registry, SDK executor or bundler is created. Document identity checks and checker admission remain unchanged; document.status keeps its independent lightweight profile.

sections.title: Bounds And Projection
sections.text: Each read has a unique id, operation, data and optional distinct top-level fields. Supported reads reuse existing catalog/specialist preflight before source loading or SDK effects; legacy handler-only nested validation and unresolved native references remain individual read errors. maxItems limits entries per object/array; maxDepth limits nesting; maxStringBytes bounds UTF-8 strings. Missing fields and truncation produce partial with reasons. maxBytes bounds the serialized result; oversized rows lose their result explicitly, and tiny budgets may omit status rows with omittedReads. Input is limited to 262144 UTF-8 bytes. These are output bounds, not bounds on native traversal cost.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: The normal CAD envelope contains result:{status:pass|partial,items:[{id,operation,status:pass|partial|unsupported|error,result?,reasons?,error?}],readOnly:true,modelValidation:not-performed,omittedReads?,reason?}. An individual read error does not stop later reads. pass means complete projection of successfully executed reads, not model acceptance. Nested nonpassing evidence is retained and makes the row partial; no fail, unknown or unsupported result is promoted to a geometry pass. ReadOnly metadata describes the selected services, not an independent SDK enforcement claim. maxBytes applies to this result object, not the outer CAD envelope or transport framing.

examples.label: Bound Body Inspection
examples.requires: An existing document selected with --doc and preferably --doc-id or --doc-file-id; discover actual references before inspecting entities. No activation or mutation is requested.
examples.output: The entities projection is returned with pass only when complete. A collection over 20 entries returns partial/maxItems. This is not a geometry acceptance result.

verified: catalog-owned readonly inventory and unchanged identity/checker boundary
bounded projections, unsupported services, errors and nonpassing evidence stay explicit
shared graph/source cache invalidates on source/build changes without skipping hashing
20-read fake comparator reports actual generated artifact sizes and preparation times, without native claims
